lore.forgotten_dimensions.terminal.1: Archive I — The Architects charted seven worlds beyond the sky, the sea and the stone.
lore.forgotten_dimensions.terminal.2: Archive II — Each world was bound to ours by a portal and guarded by a Warden of its own.
lore.forgotten_dimensions.terminal.3: Archive III — A hunger awoke between the worlds. We named it the World Devourer.
lore.forgotten_dimensions.terminal.4: Archive IV — To starve it, we shattered the portals. This was the Great Collapse.
lore.forgotten_dimensions.terminal.5: Archive V — The fragments fell into the earth. Whoever gathers them may open the way again.
lore.forgotten_dimensions.terminal.6: Archive VI — The Wardens were corrupted by the Devourer's hunger. Only their defeat frees the seventh path.
lore.forgotten_dimensions.terminal.7: Archive VII — Beyond the last portal waits the Void. End what we could only delay.
